title: Drag and drop files to OS file manager
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes # https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/50

Creates method drag_files(PackedStringArray) on Window object. To be used as reverse to drop_files method.

Allows "dnd" drag and drop of files from Godot on to the windowing OS

## Testing
Manually tested on Linux/MacOs/Windows
Minimal test project: [dnd_2_os.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28728455/dnd_2_os.zip)

## Known Issues
- In Windows DoDragDrop is Synchronous; game will remain frozen until drag completes
- In XWayland initial drag of X11 will be forbidden icon, known issue with [xWayland](https://discuss.kde.org/t/drag-and-drop-incorrect-cursor-on-xwayland/30540/5).
- Running Windows exe in wine on linux fails to start drag with error
 >0144:fixme:shell:SHCreateDataObject 0000000000000000 0 0000000000000000 0000000000000000 {0000010e-0000-0000-c000-000000000046} 000000000091EDE0: stub

## Usage

```GDScript
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.is_pressed():
			get_window().drag_files(PackedStringArray(["/AbsolutPathToFile/file.txt"]))
```

## Additional information
Macos support provided by @bruvzg [patch](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119949#issuecomment-4601959238)

Windows method void DisplayServerWindows::window_drag_files(const PackedStringArray &p_files, DisplayServerEnums::WindowID p_window) in file platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp
 entirely coded by AI Google LLM, code here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120095/changes#diff-b39afbf5546f4c9f98975d98ac464ebec9f8df4098229ad2267c7cba3d82ac4b
